verdict.rationale: Zep exposes API/SDK calls for adding messages (thread.add_messages), searching the graph (semantic+BM25), deleting nodes/edges, and updating via ingestion, plus a Memory MCP Server that lets an agent invoke these operations itself mid-conversation as tools. This directly matches the story of an agent managing its own memory through tool/API calls. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of an agent autonomously invoking these APIs mid-conversation (only vendor docs cited), and no evidence of an explicit 'update' API distinct from add/delete.
